annotations.title: Release an escrow to the payee

description: Release an escrow to the payee. Payer only, while funded or submitted. Pays the payee the amount less fee_bps (pending while the payee's payout delay runs). Answers 501 feature_unavailable while stand-alone escrow is switched off (ESCROW_API_ENABLED).
